manage.title: Manage Employees
manage.helpLine1: Create, edit, and remove employees. Send a message with a handbook link, and re-send when needed. Choose which profiles are <bold>Public</bold> (visible in the info list) per employee or use the bulk visibility buttons.
manage.helpLine2: Use work emails/phones where possible so notifications arrive reliably.
manage.noEmployees: No employees yet. Try refetching or add your first employee.
manage.noEmployeesDesc: Try refetching or add your first employee.

form.emergency.nameDesc: Name of the person who we will contact in case of emergency.
form.emergency.mobileDesc: The number will be used to contact your relative in case of emergency.
form.emergency.makePublicSuffix: to seek your relative's permission to make their contact details public. Once public, their information will be visible in the infolist.

form.statusDesc: Untick to block access, but keep the employee in the list without the license counting.
form.permSenior: Senior employee. Allow the employee to view the management handbook.
form.permAdmin: Business administrator. Allow the employee to edit and change the handbook.

infoList.title: Information List
infoList.helpDesc: Here you can view all employees and assign them these employment type.

stats.helpDetail: See employee activities like when they last visited the employee handbook and what pages they viewed.
stats.helpAll: See employee activities like when they last visited the employee handbook and what pages they viewed for all employees.

messageLogs.helpDetail: See which messages have been sent to your employees and when. Click <bold>View All Messages</bold> to see all messages sent to all employees.
messageLogs.helpAll: See which messages have been sent to your employees and when.
followUp.title: Follow Up
followUp.helpDesc: Send employees a follow-up message with access to the personnel handbook via email and/or SMS.
followUp.subject: Subject
followUp.enableChannelPreview: Enable at least one channel (Email or SMS) to preview.
followUp.enableChannelSidebar: Enable at least one channel (Email or SMS) from the sidebar.
followUp.toast.selectEmployee: Please select at least one employee.
followUp.toast.enableChannel: Please enable at least one message channel.
infoListLinks.title: Links
infoListLinks.helpDesc: Select the pages to include, write or edit their content, and mark a page Ready when it matches exactly what you want. Only pages that are selected and Ready will be published. You can also create your own pages and themes.
infoListLinks.subtext: These links are all displayed in the info list.
infoListLinks.noteDesc: Add other links by entering text and link (URL). Delete links by simply deleting the text and link in the fields. Add more links by filling in the bottom and clicking Save and Add.

rolesModal.desc: Select an employee to manage their role and permissions
